description: Collection of the former Muzium TUDM at RMAF Kuala Lumpur (Sungai Besi), which closed to the public in 2017 when the base was handed over for the Bandar Malaysia redevelopment. The airframes were trucked to RMAF Sendayan in phases from 2020-2021 and are held there, largely unsheltered and without public access, pending completion of the purpose-built museum at Bandar Baru Sendayan (RM45m project, tender 2025, target opening for the RMAF 70th anniversary in June 2028). Inventory as listed by the pre-move aviationmuseum.eu survey; arrival at Sendayan of this individual airframe is not separately confirmed.
